Text: A new version of Grok Voice just came out, and I can't stop playing with it, it's really good. Super fast, and you can interrupt it all you want and it doesn't seem to skip a beat.

Thought I'd put together a little thread on some of the things worth trying if you haven't jammed with it yet.

Soooo, join me in a little cool things to try with Grok Voice thread 🧵
